items.q: Captain John would go away; he would be away for the weekend... So we was over there with a few of us playing the music

ctx.x: the town is, in Mississippi on... We'd go there Saturday, Saturday night.

See, Captain John would go away; he would be away for the weekend, you know. So they would party from Saturday night to Sunday night, then they had to be straight with the house clean for Monday, you know. At least their part of the house, where they... They had like a big room, like this, but they had this sheet down on one side for the dancing and refreshments, and the other side was for gambling. So we was over there with a few of us playing the music, you know. So every once in a while, they'd ...(?). They'd…
